activity_statements.statement: writes and underwrites personal lines auto, homeowners, life, marine, personal excess liability (umbrella), and small business insurance directly to policyholders without independent agents
operates 44 branch locations nationwide as a direct-writing mutual insurer licensed in all 50 US states
manages approximately $6.3 billion in company assets and approximately $62 billion in life insurance subsidiary assets under management
adjudicates insurance claims for auto, homeowners, life, and marine policies through a claims workforce serving policyholders who own the company as mutual members
offers annuity products through its life insurance subsidiary to policyholders seeking retirement income solutions

name_reality_gap: none — the name clearly signals an insurance company. The mutual ownership structure (policyholders own the company) is the main differentiator from publicly-traded competitors.
